note: Message boards (ADR-015). Keep the slugs in step with BOARDS in functions/_lib/discuss.js (test/discuss.test.mjs checks). After editing, run node tools/build-boards.mjs then node tools/menu.mjs. Starters are questions written by us and shown as ours, never posted as if a reader wrote them.

boards.name: Easter Eggs You Spotted
boards.blurb: Post the hidden details, background jokes and comic nods you caught on a rewatch.
boards.starter: What is the best easter egg you found on your own, without a video pointing it out?

boards.name: MCU Fan Theories
boards.blurb: Your theories about where the story goes and what a scene really meant. Say what in the films backs it up.
boards.starter: Which MCU fan theory do you think the films actually support, and which scene is your proof?

boards.name: Deleted Scenes
boards.blurb: Scenes that were cut, extended or changed, and whether the film was better without them.
boards.starter: Which deleted scene should have stayed in the movie?

boards.name: Characters
boards.blurb: Arcs, turning points and the characters you think were handled best or worst.
boards.starter: Whose character arc across the MCU do you think was written best?

boards.name: Iron Man Films
boards.blurb: Iron Man (2008), Iron Man 2 and Iron Man 3: details, callbacks and debates.
boards.starter: Which Iron Man film holds up best on a rewatch, and why?

boards.name: Avengers Films
boards.blurb: The Avengers through Endgame and the Avengers films still to come.
boards.starter: What small moment in The Avengers (2012) pays off later in Endgame?

boards.name: Spider-Man
boards.blurb: Peter Parker in the MCU, from Civil War to Brand New Day.
boards.starter: What do you most want to see in Spider-Man: Brand New Day?

boards.name: Coming Soon and Rumors
boards.blurb: Upcoming movies and shows. Label rumors as rumors and link where you read them.
boards.starter: Which upcoming MCU release are you most looking forward to?

boards.name: Rankings and Favorites
boards.blurb: Rank the films, villains, suits and scenes. Tell us why.
boards.starter: Rank your top three MCU villains and say why.

boards.name: Quiz and Trivia
boards.blurb: Share your quiz rank, argue about answers and post trivia questions of your own.
boards.starter: Which quiz question tripped you up the most?

boards.name: General Marvel Talk
boards.blurb: Anything Marvel that does not fit another board.
boards.starter: What got you into the MCU?

boards.name: Site Ideas
boards.blurb: Tell us what to add or fix on MCU Easter Eggs.
boards.starter: What should we add to the site next?
